provenance.notes: Researched definition in tools/extract/patterns/src/extra-1.mjs. Bindings are cited but not all checked against a primary source; roles and key names are cross-checked mechanically against apg-skeleton.json and aria-roles.json. Arabic name is an unreviewed translation.

attributes.name: aria-controls
attributes.values: IDREF of the content while open

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.values: IDREF of its title; otherwise aria-label

keyboard.action: On the trigger: toggle the popover.
Close the popover and return focus to the trigger.
Move through the focusable elements of the content; from the last one, leave to the element after the trigger in the page sequence and close.
Move backward through the content; from the first one, return to the trigger.

focus.entry: On open, focus moves to the first focusable element of the content, or to the content container.
focus.exit: Tab past either end leaves and closes; a press outside closes; focus is not trapped. The content behaves as if it followed the trigger in the tab order even when rendered in a portal.
focus.restore: To the trigger on Escape or programmatic close; not when the user pressed another focusable element outside.
focus.tabStops: The trigger; while open, the content's focusable elements.

variants: hover card (pointer only, no focus move)
data.notes: Not on an APG pattern page; the contract is the non-modal dialog as implemented by Radix and Base UI. Not direction-sensitive. Placement uses logical sides (start, end) that the positioning layer flips in RTL.
